_comment: The 損益 view's data seam. Whatever fetches positions writes <project>/.claude/stock-holdings.json in this shape - scripts/fetch-quotes-shioaji.py does it every tick, after list_positions. The band never treats this file as stale (a position does not go wrong just because nobody refreshed it in the last two minutes), but `asOf` still shows on the pnl board's title row.
_comment_price: `price`/`prevClose` are optional. The band prefers a live quote for that code - from the watchlist, or from the extra codes the feed fetches for exactly this reason (see references/quote-sources.md's 損益 section) - and only falls back to these when the feed never priced that code at all.
_comment_manual: No fetcher running? Skip this file and add a `holdings` block to stock-band.json instead: { "holdings": { "tw": [ {"code":"2330","qty":1000,"cost":980.5} ], "us": [] } }. This file wins over that block for whichever market it names.
